All original lifecycle definitions/constants remain AST-identical; only three non-economic contract-summary keys are added.

authority_bindings.current_user_validation_authorization: Required full RD27 lifecycle and same-pair shadow unit suites, including their existing synthetic replay-parity cases. No registered datasets, research replay or economic comparison.

implementation.sidecar_type: AsyncMemoryState: frozen dataclass independent of LifecyclePosition
implementation.derived_property: current_age_hours: whole elapsed hours from latest_seen_time to latest_event_time, None before memory; no wall-clock and no expiry threshold
implementation.timestamp_contract: Caller supplies completed-observation/reset timestamp and decision_time. Normalize explicit timestamps to UTC; reject NaT, wall-clock sentinel strings, future observations and backward event timestamps. No unfinished-bar inference or OHLC input is accepted.
implementation.duplicate_contract: Exact memory/trigger duplicate at current event frontier returns equal new immutable object. Conflicting duplicate or any observation behind latest event fails with RD27StateError.
implementation.trigger_contract: True requires existing memory and timestamp strictly greater than first_seen_time. Earliest valid trigger time latches until reset; refresh does not erase original establishment time. No exit is emitted.
implementation.reset_contract: Non-empty reason, nondecreasing explicit reset timestamp, future guard. Clear memory, trigger, episode and duplicate state; retain identity/enable flag and reset reason/time. Subsequent observations must be strictly after reset to reject stale lifecycle events.
implementation.disabled_contract: Memory/trigger calls return equal new immutable copies without accumulation; explicit reset still validates and records its lifecycle audit.
